android_mechanism: The complete SAX character buffer is copied on every text event; fix avoids the per-event copy
bug_description: FeedParser.extractTag locates the closing tag with xml.toLowerCase().indexOf(...), materializing a full lowercase copy of the item fragment for every extracted tag. Parsing one RSS item extracts ~6 tags (title/link/description/date/guid/author), so each refresh of a feed with N items allocates and scans ~6N full-fragment lowercase copies on the parsing thread, increasing GC pressure and feed-refresh latency.
fix_summary: The closing tag is located with a case-insensitive regex over the remaining substring, eliminating the per-tag lowercase copy while preserving case-insensitive matching semantics.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

mechanism_oracle.definition: CPU time across the refresh case window, from trace.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed performs one full-fragment toLowerCase copy per extracted tag (~6 per item); fixed none. unfixed parse CPU and GC activity > fixed by >= 15% on feeds with long descriptions.

reproduction: git -C hosts/sheafreader checkout case/sheafreader_extract_tag_tolowercase/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/sheafreader checkout case/sheafreader_extract_tag_tolowercase/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
